And the Alliance fleet it was intended to crush turned the trap against us!|[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 35">[[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]]</ref>}}
The '''Battle of the Corridor''' was a conflict in the [[Feswe Corridor]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|No! Han's leading the Rebel fleet into a trap!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars 34" />}}
[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Silas Tagge/Legends|Silas Tagge]] intended to use the [[Omega Frost/Legends|Omega Frost]], a new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], to flash-freeze the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] as it traveled through the [[Feswe Corridor]]. However his plans were thwarted when the Rebel [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed one of the Omega Frost's [[conductor tower]]s from space with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. With the weapon inactive, the Rebel forces led by the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] were able to pass through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] corridor and destroy both Silas Tagge's [[Mining Explorer]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge's]] [[General Tagge's battlecruiser|battlecruiser]]. Ulric Tagge managed to escape the destruction of his cruiser in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].
